questions.question: Which of the following articles is related to the provision of Co-operative Societies in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**243 ZH to 243 ZT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Co-operative Societies:

 
 
• The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2011 gave constitutional status and protection to cooperative societies.
 
• In this context, it made the following three changes in the constitution:
 
 
• It made the right to form cooperative societies a fundamental right (Article 191).
 
• It included a new Directive Principle of State Policy on the promotion of cooperative societies (Article 43-B2).
 
• It added a new Part IX-B in the Constitution which is entitled “The Cooperative Societies” (Articles 243-ZH to 243-ZT).

questions.question: Under the discretionary power of which Article of the Indian Constitution did the SC of India recognise sex work as a profession?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 142**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 142** of the Indian Constitution **grants discretionary power to the Supreme Court of India**.
 
• This article allows the Supreme Court to pass any decree or make any order necessary for doing complete justice in any cause or matter pending before it.
 
• It was under this discretionary power that the** Supreme Court of India recognized sex work as a profession**.
 
• The recognition aims to protect the rights and dignity of sex workers and to ensure their safety and well-being.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 142** has been used in various landmark judgments to provide comprehensive justice when existing laws are inadequate.
 
• The article empowers the Supreme Court to ensure that its orders are implemented and justice is achieved, even if it means going beyond the existing legal framework.
 
• This provision underscores the role of the judiciary in upholding the principles of justice and the rule of law in India.

questions.question:
While travelling on a train, one of the travellers started speaking against the Indian freedom struggle and its noble ideals of.

Which of the following Articles mentions the fundamental duties in relation to such circumstances?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51A (b)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51-A (b) of the Indian Constitution** delineates a fundamental duty incumbent upon every citizen to uphold and abide by the lofty principles that served as the inspiration behind the nation's struggle for independence.
 
• Article 51 of the Indian Constitution is among the Directive Principles of State Policy, grounded in Liberal-Intellectual principles.
 
• It focuses on the promotion of international peace and security.
 
• The state is mandated to:
 
 
• Promote international peace and security.
 
• Maintain just and honorable relations between nations.
 
• Foster respect for international law and treaty obligations in the dealings of organized peoples with one another.
 
• Encourage the settlement of international disputes through arbitration. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 51A(c)** of the Constitution of India mandates that each citizen has the responsibility to safeguard and preserve the nation's unity, integrity, and sovereignty.
 
• **Article 51A(a) **stipulates that citizens are obliged to adhere to the Constitution, honor its principles and institutions, as well as show respect to the National Flag and the National Anthem.
 
• **Article 51A(d) **asserts that citizens are duty-bound to protect the country and contribute to national service when required. These provisions were incorporated into the Constitution through the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976.

questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India has a provision for the Constitution of Legislatures in States?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 168.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

** Under Article-168, Constitution of Legislatures in States.**

__
 
• For every State, there shall be a **Legislature which shall consist of the Governor.**

 
 
• Only **Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana, and Uttar Pradesh **out of 28 states have bicameral legislatures, with the remaining states having a unicameral one.
 
• **In other States**, **one House.**
 
 
 
• There are** two Houses of the Legislature of a State,** the **First Legislative Council and the second Legislative Assembly,** and where there is only one House, it shall be known as the** Legislative Assembly.**

questions.question:
Poshan Abhiyaan is a program to achieve nutritional status of children from 0 to 6 years.

Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution provides for raising the nutrition level?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 47.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 47** states that "the State shall regard the raising of the **level of nutrition** and the **standard of living **of its people and the improvement of **public health **as among its primary duties".
 
• This article emphasizes the importance of improving the** overall health and well-being** of the citizens of India, including their nutritional status.
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan** is a flagship scheme of the Government of India launched in** 2018 **to improve the** nutritional status** of children and pregnant women.
 
• The scheme aims to reduce** stunting, undernutrition, and low birth weight** by 2% annually and focuses on the first **1,000 day**s of a child's life.
 
• The scheme covers various interventions such as the promotion of **breastfeeding, complementary feeding, micro-nutrient supplementation, and hygiene and sanitation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 44** pertains to the **Uniform Civil Code **and aims to promote the welfare of the people by securing a uniform civil code throughout the country.
 
• **Article 46 **provides for the promotion of educational and economic interests of the** weaker sections of society,** including Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
 
• **Article 45** provides for free and compulsory education for all children until they complete the age of **14 years.**
